name: Finjan Shop & Cafe
notes: 4 photos. Photos 2 and 3 are two different priced boards for this Turkish/smoothie cafe (an indoor 'Fingan Cafe' board and an outdoor freestanding sign) with overlapping items at different prices (e.g. Turkish Mocha 7.79/6.75 on photo 2 vs 4.99/5.99 on photo 3); merged, keeping photo 2's price where an item appears on both and adding photo 3's unique items/prices otherwise, hence medium confidence. Photos 1 and 4 are the same unpriced generic Smartfruit promotional poster (no restaurant-set prices) and were skipped as non-menu signage.
